name: Improved Quality
summary: Pratt McGrubben has heard of hides better still than the last. Up in the north of Feralas, inside Rage Scar Hold, roams another throng of yetis, tougher than those you faced before. Ten of their hides are wanted at Feathermoon Stronghold.

sections.title: A Tougher Throng of Yetis
sections.body: After The Mark of Quality, Pratt McGrubben has found a lead on a still finer supply of hides. Up in the north of Feralas, inside Rage Scar Hold, another throng of yetis lives, tougher than the ones you faced earlier. Pratt McGrubben will pay handsomely for ten of their hides, brought back to Feathermoon Stronghold to settle the matter. If they match the quality of the Feral Scar hides, they could prove as resilient as thorium.

sections.title: Pratt's Thanks
sections.body: The hides are even better than hoped. Pratt McGrubben can already tell they will turn much harder once properly cured, and hands you one of the latest creations as thanks.

faq.q: Who asks for the Rage Scar yeti hides?
faq.answer: Pratt McGrubben, at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

faq.q: Where do the Rage Scar yetis live?
aliases: where to get rage scar hides
faq.answer: Inside Rage Scar Hold, in the north of Feralas.
Pratt McGrubben wants ten Rage Scar yeti hides.

aliases: what quest leads to improved quality
faq.answer: It follows The Mark of Quality, when you dealt with the first throng of yetis.
